workflow_entry: Choose phase and a verified applicable entry from .dual-agent/docs/STEWARD_ORCHESTRATION_RULES.zh-CN.md section 9; plan/audit/summarize are not a mandatory sequence and do not publish automatically.
read_session: Use the target project verified ReadSession capability; byte-read reuse does not prove semantic-result reuse or candidate/live path equivalence.

orchestration.coverage: Default full review;explicit user-approved affected-only coverage overrides it without automatic expansion or reduction.
orchestration.inventory: One attributable content inventory per stable baseline;reuse it across scope/history checks,with drift validation.
orchestration.external_candidate: Reuse one candidate per logical operation;no fresh whole-history copy for each state or failed step.
orchestration.check_key: Task/round,checker or probe SHA/version,exact argv/selector,input bytes/environment/artifact fingerprints,state/event head,and relevant path/inventory semantics.
orchestration.dispatch_business_tests: Not run by default;governance publication does not require implementation acceptance suites.
orchestration.reuse_record: Original independent evidence path/SHA,matching check key,coverage and invalidation basis;never implementation self-report as independent proof.
orchestration.rerun_reason: Required only for affected input/state/environment changes,invalid evidence or explicit mandatory gate;record exact reason.
orchestration.resume: Preserve failed candidate/output;resume earliest affected step and reuse unaffected valid evidence.
orchestration.publication: Finalize publication bytes,check one candidate,guard input stability,publish and read back actual paths/bytes/new bindings. Recheck affected assertions for declared release-time fields;no default second full history check.
orchestration.publication_reuse_basis: Bind the original independent result and coverage,input/object content stability,event prefix and candidate/live path semantics;prefix equality or metadata alone is insufficient.
orchestration.full_check_fallback: Before fallback record missing proof,inspected tool capabilities,why local verification is insufficient,exact command/coverage and cost or unknown;cite any explicit mandatory frozen gate. No invented incremental support.
orchestration.costs: Separate measured/estimated wall intervals,tool execution,Steward preparation/documentation,interactive idle and rework;record overlap and unknowns.
orchestration.runner_reuse: List reviewed runner path/version/SHA and task data first;do not regenerate whole flows by default. Historical scripts need external output-safe adaptations;unavailable is explicit,not invented automation.
orchestration.count_preflight: Derive implementation/test/doc,report,Steward-output and total-delta counts from actual path sets;do not hardcode implementation count as report-inclusive scope gate.
orchestration.permission_preflight: Normalize allowed/denied paths and require no intersection before expensive checks. Current authorized report positive;old and unauthorized future reports negative.
orchestration.evidence_collection: Persist raw results once immediately;canonical verdict/index/human view reference them. Retain necessary durable copies,unique assertions and failed attempts.
orchestration.interactive_process: Consecutive ready/health/real signal/native-child exit/resource checks;avoid documentation idle gaps. Separate PTY-shell exit and manual waiting from native execution.

timing_plan.wall_clock: Record actual start/end and elapsed;label measured versus estimated intervals.
timing_plan.overlap: Record parallel overlap;sum of command durations is not total wall time.
timing_plan.unmeasured: unknown/null;timestamp gaps do not prove exact thinking or execution time.

storage_validation.deletion_rule: No sole required evidence copy in Temp;retain formal history and still-referenced baseline objects.
storage_validation.loss_handling: Recover or mark precise proof unproven;continue safe independent checks with trusted inputs;no automatic waiver or current-bytes reconstruction of old baseline.
